description: One translator is stepping off a project and another must inherit unresolved terminology questions, client preferences, style exceptions, and unfinished review threads without losing semantic context. All clients and products are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 29-year-old translator inheriting a partially completed enterprise localization project
user_profile.context: The original translator left strong notes in some areas and almost none in others, making continuity fragile
user_profile.communication_style: Careful and context-sensitive, wants the handoff material organized by decision type rather than raw chronology

fact_sheet.fact: The project code is AEI-QL-DE-2024-007, covering the localization of QuantumLeap CRM v3.5 from English (US) to German (DE).
The final delivery deadline for all translated UI strings and documentation is November 30, 2024, at 5:00 PM CET.
The project manager at OmniLingua Solutions is Sarah Jenkins, reachable at s.jenkins@omnilingua.solutions.
The project's JIRA board for tracking tasks and issues is accessible at https://jira.omnilingua.net/projects/QLDE.
The departing translator, Liam Chen, has logged 112 hours out of an estimated total of 200 hours for the project.
The primary client contact at Aethelred Innovations is Dr. Anya Sharma, Head of Product, reachable at anya.sharma@aethelred.dev.
All project-related communication with the client must happen in the dedicated Slack channel: #aei-quantumleap-de-localization.
Aethelred Innovations has explicitly requested that the term 'customer' always be translated as 'Kunde' and never 'Auftraggeber'.
The client's in-country reviewer is Klaus Richter, and his feedback is the final authority on linguistic choices.
The official project termbase is named `Aethelred_QL_v3.5.sdltb` and is located in the project's central repository.
The term 'Synergy Matrix' is unresolved; JIRA ticket QLDE-112 tracks the discussion on whether to use 'Synergiematrix' or 'Synergie-Matrix'.
Liam Chen's last note on QLDE-112 from October 15, 2024, indicates the client was leaning towards the hyphenated 'Synergie-Matrix'.
The proposed translation for 'Actionable Insight' is 'Handlungsorientierte Einblicke', which is pending approval from Klaus Richter.
The product feature 'Data Weaver' should remain in English and be marked as a non-translatable term.
All terminology query forms must be submitted via the client portal at https://portal.aethelred.dev/localization/queries by Friday each week.
The Aethelred Innovations German Style Guide v2.1 is the authoritative source and is stored at `\OLS-SERVER-01\Projects\AE_Innovations\StyleGuides\DE_StyleGuide_v2.1.pdf`.
A major style exception is the mandatory use of the Oxford comma in German marketing text, as per a client directive from May 12, 2024.
The tone of voice for UI microcopy should be 'Helpful and Professional', avoiding colloquialisms.
Liam Chen noted in an email on September 23, 2024, that the client prefers the formal 'Sie' for user address in all contexts.
There is an open JIRA ticket, QLDE-98, to update the official style guide with the Oxford comma exception; this has not yet been completed.
The required CAT tool for this project is Trados Studio 2022 Professional, build 17.0.5.15348.
The project package, `AEI-QL-DE-2024-007_Package_v2.sdlppx`, was created on October 10, 2024.
The main translation memory (TM) is hosted on a server and must be accessed via the connection path `tm.omnilingua.net:5432`.
Liam's working files are located at `\OLS-SERVER-01\Users\lchen\Projects\AEI-QL-DE-2024-007\InProgress\`.
A custom QA check profile, `Aethelred_DE_QA.sdltb`, must be used in Trados Studio for verification.
Klaus Richter's feedback from the previous milestone (v3.4) is in an Excel file named `AEI_QL_v3.4_Review_KR_Final.xlsx` in the project's root folder.
There is an unresolved review thread regarding the translation of the button 'Engage'. Klaus Richter found the initial translation 'Einbinden' too generic.
The review thread for 'Engage' is documented in a comment chain on Confluence: https://confluence.omnilingua.net/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8675309.
Liam's last proposed alternative for 'Engage' was 'Interagieren', submitted on October 18, 2024, but it has not yet been reviewed by Klaus.
A bug was logged (QLDE-121) for a string truncation issue in the German UI on the 'Dashboard Settings' modal.
The client has a strict character limit of 45 characters for all main menu navigation items.
The project budget allows for up to 10 hours of dedicated linguistic research, of which Liam Chen has used 3.5 hours.
The term 'Legacy System' was approved on September 5, 2024, to be translated as 'Altsystem'.
